title: DoctorReport
description:
Result of `doctor`: one pass over every lifecycle invariant in
`docs/action-map/lifecycle-states.md`'s Invariants section, over the
whole scope (every root `scan` knows, every registry and lockfile
entry, the quarantine dirs, the journal), independent of any single
command's own rollback logic.

listing_cost.description: Estimated skill listing cost per harness and session scope.

violations.description: Every violation found; empty means a healthy scope.

checked.description:
Skills the pass examined for invariants 1-4 (link, registry,
lockfile, two-states); invariants 5 (quarantine) and 6 (journal)
check one directory and one journal each regardless of skill count,
so this does not add them in.

ListingCost.description: Listing cost for one harness in one session scope.

scope.description: Project sessions include global skills. Identity rules depend on the harness.

estimated_tokens_chars_div_4.description: UTF-16 characters, divided by four and rounded up.

limit_tokens.description: Budget in estimated tokens, or null when not verified.

limit_source.description: Setting file path, default, or reason the limit is unknown.

context_window_tokens.description: Context size used for a fractional budget.

uses_default_context_window.description: Whether a verified fallback was used instead of a session context size.

top_skills.description: The five largest entries, with names as a stable tie break.

AgentIdentity.description:
Kebab-case harness identifier, for example `claude-code` or `open-code`.

Invariant: the string is the serde wire name used by the desktop app
today. `open-code` is canonical; `opencode` is only a CLI binary name and
is never stored in an `AgentId`.

ProjectRef.description:
Absolute path of a tracked project directory.

Invariant: the path is canonical inside a [`crate::scope::NormalizedScope`].
Wire values are the lexical path the caller gave.

ListingSkillCost.description: One skill's contribution to the listing.

estimated_tokens_chars_div_4.description: UTF-16 characters, divided by four and rounded up.

DoctorViolation.description:
One violation of a [`crate::doctor::DoctorInvariant`] found by `doctor`,
projected from `crate::doctor::DoctorViolation` into a serializable
shape: `skill` folds into `detail`'s message text rather than a
separate field, since every existing violation message already names
the skill when it has one (see each `doctor::check_*` function).

severity.description: Warning for a retained entry or external link; error for broken state.

path.description: Path of the offending entry, when the invariant names one.

Severity.description:
How serious an issue is.

Invariant: `Error` blocks a mutation on the deployment; `Warning` does
not; `Off` is informational (the deployment is intentionally disabled).

oneOf.description: Must be fixed before the deployment can be changed.

DoctorInvariant.description:
One of the six doctor invariants from `lifecycle-states.md`. Carries
`Serialize`/`Deserialize`/`JsonSchema` (unlike the rest of this
detect-only module) because `ops::doctor`'s [`crate::dto::DoctorReport`]
crosses the CLI/desktop/MCP boundary and needs to name which invariant a
violation is.

oneOf.description: 1. Every link resolves inside its root.
2. Every registry entry has a folder.
3. Every lockfile entry has a folder.
4. No folder is in two states at once.
5. Quarantine stays within its retention cap.
6. The journal has no open plan at rest.
